# Silk Room (silkroom.shop)

Silk Room is a men's clothing brand from Surat, Gujarat, India.
Official store: https://www.silkroom.shop

Also known as: Silkroom, Silkroom.shop, Silk Room Shop.

We sell men's polo t-shirts — ribbed zip polos and waffle zip polos — at ₹399 each,
3 for ₹799, 5 for ₹1,299. Sizes S, M, L, XL. Prepaid checkout. Delivery across India.

Shop: https://www.silkroom.shop/shop
Men's polo t-shirts: https://www.silkroom.shop/mens-polo-tshirts
About: https://www.silkroom.shop/about
Contact: https://www.silkroom.shop/contact
